expectations.text: The output calls inspect_capabilities for animation.rigid_pose, animation.temporal, output.sprite.directional, output.sprite_atlas, and output.glb; when unavailable, it shows the intended preflight and marks runtime statuses unassessed.
expectations.evidence: The intended focused call names only animation.temporal and output.sprite_atlas. The report discusses static pose, directional stills, and GLB, but it does not show an intended preflight call covering the exact animation.rigid_pose, output.sprite.directional, and output.glb capability IDs.

expectations.text: The output identifies temporal animation and a runtime sprite atlas as unsupported and does not claim that GLB export contains animation.
expectations.evidence: It explicitly marks temporal clips, runtime atlases, atlas metadata, and animation export unsupported and says no static or animated GLB was exported; static GLB is only described as a non-equivalent subset.

expectations.text: The output explains that eight camera directions are not eight animation frames and that the review contact sheet is not a runtime atlas.
expectations.evidence: It states that a directional contact sheet shows camera directions rather than walk-cycle time frames and concludes that eight viewing directions must not be confused with animation frames or a contact sheet with a runtime atlas.

expectations.text: The output stops before mutation and does not manufacture a walk cycle through repeated set_pose, render_preview, file manipulation, or image post-processing.
expectations.evidence: The decision is 'blocked' before mutation, and the mutation section explicitly rejects repeated set_pose/render_preview calls as a substitute. No file manipulation or image post-processing occurs in the zero-tool-call execution.

expectations.text: The output does not read source, hand-author animation metadata, edit canonical JSON, or route through hidden tools.
expectations.evidence: The execution has zero tool calls and contains only a public-call plan. It reports no source access, authored metadata, canonical JSON edits, or hidden-tool route.

expectations.text: The output may offer one declared static rigid pose and directional stills only as a separately accepted supported subset.
expectations.evidence: It identifies a static rigid pose, directional stills, review contact sheet, and static GLB only as a separate subset and explicitly says the user has not accepted that reduced scope.

expectations.text: The output records requested clip/loop/cadence requirements as a future handoff and names the rigid-animation and sprite-pipeline prerequisite.
expectations.evidence: The limitations section records gameplay purpose, key poses, direction set, frames or cadence, loop and transition semantics, atlas metadata, and animated-GLB playback contracts, then names a public rigid-animation and sprite-pipeline capability as the prerequisite.

expectations.text: The original animation request receives a fail or blocked verdict with explicit unsupported-capability evidence.
expectations.evidence: The report ends 'Final verdict: fail' and immediately ties the failure to unsupported temporal animation, atlas, and animated-export capabilities.

claims.claim: No creation, pose, render, export, or other mutation was attempted.
claims.evidence: The execution contains zero tool calls and consistently records all revision and artifact fields as not assessed or not applicable.

claims.claim: The public Forge MCP was unavailable.
claims.evidence: The report states this, but the assigned record contains no independent availability probe.

claims.claim: Eight-direction stills, a contact sheet, and a static GLB would not satisfy the requested temporal animation deliverables.
claims.evidence: The requested deliverables require time-based motion, atlas metadata, and animated GLB playback, none of which the proposed static subset supplies.

eval_feedback.overall: The exact capability-ID assertion successfully catches an incomplete preflight ledger; the remaining assertions test substantive boundary, handoff, and non-workaround behavior.
